nodes.rationale: Do not show the Road to DevFest / GDG Jakarta win anywhere (PanduArah is labeled Own Project). The PT Clipan Finance entry must stay modest and front-end only (no CI/CD, Jenkins, Playwright, API design or back-end claims). Every visible text needs both an English and an Indonesian version. The Nara chat widget must follow the site style (public/nara-widget.css, passed through the css attribute, reads the page CSS variables so dark mode follows automatically); its own language button is hidden and the site toggle drives its language. Kinetic type and ASCII animations must stay in the site style, respect prefers-reduced-motion, and the rotating words must only name work that the site already shows.
